name: Mesh Shader Tetrahedron Intersection Optimization
aliases: Accelerated intersections using wave intrinsics within a mesh shader
definition: An optimized implementation of the Cyrus-Beck algorithm for computing ray-tetrahedron intersections, leveraging mesh shader wave intrinsics to share information between the four vertices of a tetrahedron, reducing memory loads by a factor of four and reducing runtime cost to 12 FLOPs.
